description: This file is a shell script used to test git's handling of pathnames with funny characters such as tabs, quotes, and spaces in various git commands and diff outputs.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if the required prerequisites (like MINGW) are available.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Adds files to the git index, possibly with funny characters in filenames.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a new tree object from the current index.

methods.name: git ls-files
methods.description: Lists files in the index with potential handling of filenames with special characters.

methods.name: git ls-tree
methods.description: Displays the contents of a tree object, showing filenames possibly with funny characters.

methods.name: git diff-index
methods.description: Shows changes between the working tree/index and a tree, handling filenames with special characters.

methods.name: git diff-tree
methods.description: Shows the diff between two tree objects, including filenames with special characters.

methods.name: git apply
methods.description: Applies a patch; used here for tests involving diffs.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_skip
methods.description: Skips tests if prerequisites are not met.
